title: Oh My Pi MCP Server Config
description: The .omp/mcp.json file that registers the word-tools server for Oh My Pi, with the command and the script it runs.

steps.description: This is `.omp/mcp.json`, saved in your project. The page says to type `/mcp list` inside Oh My Pi to confirm it, or `/mcp test word-tools` to try the connection.
`mcpServers` defines one server, `word-tools`, the same name used in the opencode config.
`command` is `python3`, and `args` passes `word_count_server.py`, the MCP server file from the previous section.
